summary.text: Josey Garcia is a Democratic state representative from San Antonio who has represented Texas House District 124 since January 2023 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She served in the U.S. Air Force and co-founded the nonprofit Uniting America Outreach.

paragraphs.text: Josey Garcia lives in San Antonio, Texas, and served in the U.S. Air Force.
Her career experience includes working as an author and co-founding the nonprofit Uniting America Outreach.
Garcia succeeded Ina Minjarez in representing District 124 and assumed office on January 10, 2023.
In the 2023-2024 session she was assigned to the Culture, Recreation, & Tourism Committee and the Defense & Veterans' Affairs Committee.
She defeated Sylvia Soto in the November 5, 2024 general election, 61.5% to 38.5%, and advanced from the March 3, 2026 Democratic primary with no opponent.
Ballotpedia lists Sylvia Soto (Republican) and L.D. Howard (Independent) as her opponents in the 2026 general election.
